title: Shrink Responsibly: Empirical Bayes in Economics
abstract: arXiv:2611.21230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Empirical researchers are often interested in the relative causal impact of individuals or institutions such as teachers, schools, hospitals, or neighborhoods. Regression-based estimates of such unit-specific parameters are often noisy; empirical Bayes (eB) methods can help isolate the signal from the estimation noise. This article provides an overview of eB methodology, showing how eB shrinkage can improve compound decisions---such as selecting individuals with the highest causal impacts---even when the working model motivating the shrinkage is misspecified. Not all analyses benefit from eB shrinkage, however, and we discuss which types of causal summaries are best estimated directly and how to do so robustly. We illustrate practical takeaways with a running analysis of public elementary and middle school value-added.

translated_title: 负责任地收缩：经济学中的经验贝叶斯方法
translated_abstract: 实证研究者常常关注个体或机构（如教师、学校、医院或社区）的相对因果影响。基于回归的此类单元特定参数估计往往噪声较大，而经验贝叶斯（eB）方法可以帮助从估计噪声中分离出信号。本文对经验贝叶斯方法进行了综述，展示了即使驱动收缩的工作模型存在错误设定，经验贝叶斯收缩仍能改善复合决策——例如挑选出具有最高因果影响的个体。然而，并非所有分析都能从经验贝叶斯收缩中受益，本文讨论了哪些类型的因果汇总量最适合直接估计，以及如何稳健地进行这类估计。作者通过对公立小学和初中增值效应的贯穿式分析，阐述了实践中的要点。
tldr: 本文系统综述了经济学中的经验贝叶斯收缩方法，证明即使底层模型设定有误，收缩仍能改善复合决策（如挑选因果影响最大的单元），并指明了哪些因果汇总量应直接稳健估计而非依赖收缩。
en_tdlr: This paper surveys empirical Bayes shrinkage in economics, showing that shrinkage improves compound decisions (such as selecting the highest-impact units) even when the working model is misspecified, while clarifying which causal summaries are best estimated directly and robustly without shrinkage.
